results.title: Grete and the Cuban Pianist
results.overview: A chance encounter with acclaimed Cuban American pianist Aruán Ortiz gives Grete Skarpeid the opportunity to pursue a lifelong dream. In her sixties, she takes a leap of faith, recording her debut album with renowned jazz musicians in New York and performing at Havana’s legendary jazz festival.

results.title: End of the Wall
results.overview: The desert between Sásabe and Nogales. It was there, in 2020, that a wall stretching along the border was erected. Thirty kilometres further on, the wall of rusted steel bars comes to an end, and the border between the US and Mexico is marked only by hills and ravines. Due to extreme droughts and heat, this stretch is one of the most dangerous overland migration routes in the world. On the American side of the border, a group of volunteers is providing aid to thousands of migrants, supplying them with water, food, and medical assistance. Each of them has different motivations, but they are united by one thing: a refusal to stand idly by and look the other way.

results.title: METEORIT
results.overview: A foreigner comes to a Moldovan village looking for a meteorite that fell nearby, as life there flows at its own pace.

results.title: Thank You for Thinking of Me
results.original_title: Thank You for Thinking of Me
results.overview: At the height of 2020’s Black Lives Matter protests, a young mother fights for her innocence after surviving a near death car accident while mistakenly injuring a police officer.

results.title: Shortparis. Любовь моя будет тут
results.overview: A film about how the concept of humanism is refracted through the band’s work. Faces and voices fill the frame, the surrounding space, the auditorium, and everyone watching the screen with meaning. Simple conversations about dreams, fears, favorite foods, or childhood memories are no longer idle chatter, but a way to bridge the distance—an attempt, time and again, to truly see the person before you, even when the instinct to look away is at its strongest.

results.title: Men Die Sooner
results.overview: Felipe returns to the family farm for the anniversary of his father's death, where his mother Sandra, brother Sebastián, and young nephew Sebas live. In the boy, Felipe recognizes a process he knows too well: the transformation of a boy into a "man." He watches Sebas absorb the rules of a world where shame is used to teach, cruelty is mistaken for affection, and pain goes unnamed. The emotional inheritance shared by the men in his family threatens to turn intimacy into violence.

results.title: La última transmisión de las Nereidas
results.original_title: La última transmisión de las Nereidas

results.title: Carapace
results.overview: When her teenage daughter decides to leave home to study, Maite feels the world she has built begin to fall apart. As the fear of losing her takes hold, a strange presence begins to spread through the house, contaminating both the space and the bond between mother and daughter.

results.title: Lo que nos une
results.overview: Several years after a TV-related controversy, three former friends meet to make a film that explores the borders between fact and fiction.

results.title: The Banning Curse
results.overview: After the critical success of his first film at Cannes, Amiryousefi returned to Iran to find it banned by state authorities. It's a pattern that continued through his entire career, which the seasoned director looks back on in this imaginative, satirical portrait.

results.title: Rebellion
results.overview: In 1981, 12 young Asian men stood trial on terrorism charges for defending Bradford from an imminent racist attack. Their fight for their city – and their freedom – became international news, awakening public consciousness to the rise of fascism and the far-right.

results.title: Fellas
results.overview: Over the course of an app date, Matt tells the story of his "Fellas," and the scandal they get into when a problematic DVD box set goes missing at their housewarming.

results.title: Built in a Night
results.overview: İzmir's gecekondu neighborhoods sit at the film's center. Homes built through migration, roofs raised overnight, and resistance against demolition are recalled. Hand-drawn symbols and wall slogans bring oral history to life. Archival footage, present-day filming, and drawings intertwine. The film reconstructs gecekondu's memory as a form of right to housing and resistance, tracing a forgotten era.

results.title: Moonfish
results.overview: By the sea they live—a mother and her deaf daughter. The father is far away on a fishing trip. Some whisper he’s long dead, lost to the waves. Yet the mother and daughter still cling to hope, fragile though it may be. And then, one day, a miracle comes ashore.

results.title: The Leap
results.overview: Josué is about to embark on a new chapter in his life. Together with his pregnant partner, he is preparing a room for their son and hanging photographs from the past on the walls – snippets of life from the family chronicle, to which they will soon add new chapters. Set against the backdrop of contemporary Cuba, a quiet social and relational drama centred on a young family on the threshold of an uncertain future unfolds in this delicate observation.

results.title: Doubt
results.overview: A couple of months away from his ordination, young Catholic deacon Jean decides to briefly join a remote monastery in Luxembourg to decide whether he’s more suited to monastic life. His days are spent in prayer, ritual, choir practice, and quiet observation of the peaceful life there. However, the arrival of a visitor, an attractive young man who also happens to be a benefactor to the monastery, awakens unsettling feelings Jean struggles to identify. Soon, Jean is forced to confront his convictions, but also the very foundation of his sense of belonging.

results.title: Pee Mak
results.overview: Mak, a soldier returning home from war, invites four of his comrades to meet his wife and newborn child. However, suspicion soon grows among his friends as they uncover a terrifying secret: Mak’s family is no longer among the living.
